source.author: ov
source.text: Senserat hoc olim magni matrona Tonantis distuleratque graves in idonea tempora poenas.
source.text_original: Senserat hoc olim magni matrona Tonantis / distuleratque graves in idonea tempora poenas.
source.text_english: The consort of the mighty Thunderer had long since perceived this and had postponed the heavy punishment to an opportune time.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed neque bella videt Graias neque monstra per urbes ulla: Cleonaeo iam tempora clusus hiatu Alcides; olim Lernae defensus ab angue Areas, et ambobus iam cornua fracta iuvencis.
reuse.text_original: sed neque bella videt Graias neque monstra per urbes / ulla: Cleonaeo iam tempora clusus hiatu / Alcides; olim Lernae defensus ab angue / Areas, et ambobus iam cornua fracta iuvencis.
reuse.text_english: but he sees neither wars among the Greeks nor any monsters through the cities: Alcides is now shut in by the Cleonaean chasm; long ago Arcadia was defended by the serpent of Lerna, and now the horns of both bulls have been broken.
